title: Scaffold a generator inside a workspace plugin
description: Wrap `@nx/plugin:generator` with the workspace conventions: the generator lands at `src/lib/generators/<directory>/generator.ts` in the target plugin, with a type-checked `schema.ts` exporting an `Options` interface, a minimal starter function, and a re-export from the plugin's `src/index.ts`.

examples.description: Adds a generator whose folder (`generator/`) differs from its collection key (`nx-gen`).

name.description: The generator name — its key in the target plugin's generators collection and, unless `directory` overrides it, its folder under `src/lib/generators/`. Lowercase alphanumeric words joined by single hyphens.

project.description: The plugin project to add the generator to. Must be tagged `type:plugin`.
project.x-prompt: Which plugin project should the generator be added to?

directory.description: Folder segment under the plugin's `src/lib/generators/`. Defaults to `name`; set it when the folder should differ from the collection key.

description.description: Generator description, recorded against the entry in the plugin's `generators.json`.

unitTestRunner.description: Test runner for the generated generator's spec. The workspace standardizes on Jest (ADR 0007).

skipLintChecks.description: Do not add an eslint configuration for the plugin's json files.
